tests.when: the opt-in gate helpers are called inside a test
then: the test is reported as skipped, not failed
the skip reason names the missing variable or prerequisite

tests.title: The documents name what this scope ships
given: docs and README after make doc
tests.when: the files are read
then: docs/cli.md names --sandbox values and default, --borrowed-hands, --brain claude, the four warnings, box_unconfined under none and the fix result box
docs/configuration.md and docs/model-usage.md name AF_SANDBOX, AF_SANDBOX_IMAGE, AF_MODEL to --model, claude's after-run cost check and the network per placement
docs/architecture.md has the placement table and tools image
docs/development.md names the opt-in variables and fake-claude script format
README.md mentions containers/tools/

tests.title: A developer triages an issue with the claude brain in a local box end to end
given: an httptest GitHub issue
a fake claude first on PATH that runs the hook and submits through the real af binary
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set
tests.when: af triage <issue URL> --brain claude --sandbox local runs
then: box_unconfined is raised once and box_open records placement box and network host
brief.md, run.json with prefix_bytes, guard.json and claude-settings.json were placed
the claude process ran under env -i with only the vendor key
brain_output artifacts exist on the host
<run_dir>/submission.json holds the accepted diagnosis
usage.cost_source is reported with the fake's cost and turns

tests.title: A developer fixes in place with none and a foreign commit is folded into af's commit
given: an httptest GitHub issue
a git checkout on main
a scripted brain that edits, commits on main, and submits
tests.when: af fix <issue URL> --brain scripted --sandbox none runs
then: box_unconfined says the hook is the only guard
Export is never called
foreign_commits_reset is raised with count 1
fix/<N>-<slug> has one commit with the Agent-Fox-Run trailer containing the foreign change
the foreign commit is not on main

tests.title: A developer fixes an issue inside a landlock box with all four change kinds landing in one commit
given: AF_TEST_LANDLOCK=1 on Linux with ABI 4 or newer, otherwise the test is skipped with a reason
an httptest GitHub issue and a git checkout
tests.when: af fix <issue URL> --brain scripted --sandbox landlock runs with a brain that modifies, adds, deletes, flips an executable bit and commits inside the box
then: one commit with the Agent-Fox-Run trailer holds all four changes
the in-box commit is not on the branch
files are owned by the host user
real_components: landlock provider with real agentkit sandbox

tests.title: With the default box down af fails with sandbox and never falls back
given: GOOS injected as darwin, no --sandbox and no AF_SANDBOX
the podman provider cannot reach its engine
an httptest GitHub issue
tests.when: af fix <issue URL> runs
then: status is failed/sandbox with retryable false
the message mentions podman machine start
fix_hint names --sandbox and AF_SANDBOX
no brain was started
local and none were never opened
